# New Deck Oven Commissioned 2025-11-14

The new three-deck oven passed its commissioning checks and Kofi baked the full Friday range in it. The hired oven was collected the same afternoon.

## Notes

- Installed 2025-11-10 to 2025-11-12; the three-phase supply was connected on 2025-11-07.
- Commissioning over two days with the installer and [[colm-ashworth]] ([[oven-commissioning-checklist]]).
- Friday bake: 14 bread varieties back on the list, including the two sourdoughs dropped in August.
- Training for Kofi, Joel and me on programmes, steam settings and the shutdown sequence.

## What changed

Bread on three decks at once, steam on each. Kofi's first comment: the bake finishes 40 minutes earlier. The extra capacity did not bring wholesale back: we had the oven but not the baker hours ([[why-did-we-pause-wholesale-to-cafes]]).
